title.narrative: Support and Empowerment in Water and Sanitation in Sudan

description.narrative: 1. Establish and install solar energy systems for 10 new water stations (groundwater wells) and expand distribution points with a slow sand filtered water station. 2. Rehabilitate, upgrade and install solar energy systems for 44 non-functional water stations (groundwater wells) and distribution points. 3. Establish 54 water user associations with approximately 600 members, at least 40% of whom are female. 4. Distribute water collection and storage containers to the most vulnerable households. 5. Distribute water treatment tablets to treat drinking water. 6. Provide new waste collection equipment and repair existing damaged ones. 7. Provide metal containers for garbage and waste. 8. Distribute hygiene supplies (including soap, sanitizers and handwashing water containers) to vulnerable households. 9. Provide handwashing tools including soap to 54 clubs and schools. 10. Support educational and educational materials and publications on the importance of personal hygiene for 10,000 people.
Intervention in the water and sanitation sector in Kassala and Gedaref states in Sudan and support the people of Sudan in improving the water, sanitation and hygiene situation

Support the people of Sudan to improve their water, sanitation and hygiene situation, especially for conflict-affected and displaced populations through the link between water, sanitation and hygiene.
